claims.claim: Tesla's insurance entities generated $644.2 million in direct written premiums in the first half of 2026.
claims.episode_span: Tesla’s insurance entities generated $644.2 million in direct written premiums in the first half of 2026
claims.source_title: Tesla Insurance blocked as NY regulators examine connected-car coverage
claims.supporting_quote: Tesla's insurance entities generated $644.2 million in direct written premiums during the first half of 2026.

claims.claim: The New York Department of Financial Services rejected a Tesla General Insurance Inc. filing that would have limited eligibility to Tesla vehicles identified by VIN.
claims.episode_span: rejected a filing from Tesla General Insurance Inc. that would have limited eligibility to Tesla vehicles identified by vehicle identification number
claims.source_title: Tesla Insurance blocked as NY regulators examine connected-car coverage
claims.supporting_quote: The New York Department of Financial Services rejected a filing from Tesla General Insurance Inc. that would have limited eligibility to Tesla vehicles identified through vehicle identification numbers, or VINs.

claims.claim: Regulators raised Section 2324 concerns before reviewing the filing's actuarial merits, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence.
claims.episode_span: Regulators raised concerns under Section 2324 of New York Insurance Law before reviewing the filing’s actuarial merits
claims.source_title: Tesla Insurance blocked as NY regulators examine connected-car coverage
claims.supporting_quote: Regulators raised concerns under Section 2324 of New York Insurance Law before reviewing the filing's actuarial merits, according to an analysis from S&P Global Market Intelligence.

claims.claim: In the first half of 2026, California accounted for $477.8 million of Tesla insurance premiums, Texas $60.4 million, Nevada $23.3 million, and Maryland $15 million.
claims.episode_span: California $477.8 million, Texas $60.4 million, Nevada $23.3 million, and Maryland $15 million
claims.source_title: Tesla Insurance blocked as NY regulators examine connected-car coverage
claims.supporting_quote: California accounted for $477.8 million of that total, followed by Texas at $60.4 million, Nevada at $23.3 million and Maryland at $15 million.

claims.claim: New York produced no Tesla direct written premium in the first half of 2026 despite Tesla Insurance Co. being licensed there.
claims.episode_span: New York produced no direct written premium in that period even though Tesla Insurance Co. is licensed in the state
claims.source_title: Tesla Insurance blocked as NY regulators examine connected-car coverage
claims.supporting_quote: New York produced no direct written premium during the period despite Tesla Insurance Co. being licensed in the state, according to S&P.

claims.claim: Tesla generated $1.37 billion in direct written premiums in 2025, up 40.7% from $970.8 million.
claims.episode_span: Tesla generated $1.37 billion in direct written premiums in 2025, up 40.7% from $970.8 million a year earlier
claims.source_title: Tesla Insurance blocked as NY regulators examine connected-car coverage
claims.supporting_quote: Previous research from S&P Global Market Intelligence found Tesla generated $1.37 billion in direct written premiums during 2025, up 40.7% from $970.8 million a year earlier.

claims.claim: Tesla-affiliated insurers wrote 75.9% of Tesla's insurance business directly in 2025, compared with 32.6% in 2024.
claims.episode_span: Tesla-affiliated insurers wrote 75.9% of that business directly in 2025, compared with 32.6% in 2024
claims.source_title: Tesla Insurance blocked as NY regulators examine connected-car coverage
claims.supporting_quote: Tesla-affiliated insurers wrote 75.9% of Tesla's insurance business directly in 2025, compared with 32.6% in 2024.

claims.claim: California represented nearly 70% of Tesla's 2025 insurance premium volume, at $725 million.
claims.episode_span: California remained the largest market, nearly 70% of 2025 premium volume, at $725 million
claims.source_title: Tesla Insurance blocked as NY regulators examine connected-car coverage
claims.supporting_quote: California remained Tesla's largest insurance market and represented nearly 70% of premium volume during 2025. Premium volume in the state climbed to $725 million, according to S&P.

claims.claim: Tim Zawacki said Tesla Insurance is meant to remove sales friction, not to compete for a broad segment of the market.
claims.episode_span: the purpose “is not to be a competitive source of insurance coverage for a broad segment of the market”
claims.source_title: Tesla Insurance blocked as NY regulators examine connected-car coverage
claims.supporting_quote: "Its purpose is not to be a competitive source of insurance coverage for a broad segment of the market," Zawacki said. "It's to essentially eliminate a point of friction in the Tesla sales process."

claims.claim: Google is gradually rolling out Call for me as an early preview on Pixel 11, initially only in the US.
claims.episode_span: Google is rolling out “Call for me” as an early preview on Pixel 11, initially only in the United States
claims.source_title: Google puts Gemini on the phone: AI handles calls for questions and reservations
claims.supporting_quote: Google is gradually rolling out “Call for me” as an early preview.

claims.claim: Call for me can check availability, request quotes, make reservations, navigate phone menus, and wait on hold, but cannot make emergency or marketing calls, complete payments, or share card numbers, passwords, or health information.
claims.episode_span: product-availability checks, quote requests, reservations, phone menus, and time on hold
claims.source_title: Google puts Gemini on the phone: AI handles calls for questions and reservations
claims.supporting_quote: Gemini is expected to be able to check product availability, request quotes, make reservations, navigate phone menus and wait on hold, among other things.

claims.claim: Gemini identifies itself as an AI, says the call is recorded, and users can follow a transcript, listen in, or take over.
claims.episode_span: Gemini then identifies itself as the user’s AI assistant and says the call is recorded
claims.source_title: Google puts Gemini on the phone: AI handles calls for questions and reservations
claims.supporting_quote: At the beginning of the conversation, Gemini introduces itself to the person being called as the user’s AI assistant and informs them that the call is being recorded.

claims.claim: Transcripts are stored on Google's servers, audio recordings only on the device, and neither is used to train Google's AI models.
claims.episode_span: transcripts are stored on Google’s servers, audio stays on the device, and neither is used to train Google’s models
claims.source_title: Google puts Gemini on the phone: AI handles calls for questions and reservations
claims.supporting_quote: According to Google, transcripts are stored on the company’s own servers, while audio recordings are stored only on the device. Neither is supposed to be used to train its AI models.

claims.claim: Forty-two state attorneys general are coordinating to enforce safeguards on Meta chatbots and AI agents under state consumer-protection and civil-rights laws.
claims.episode_span: 42 state attorneys general are coordinating oversight of its AI systems
claims.source_title: Meta Platforms (META) Draws 42 State Push To Police AI Chatbots And Agents
claims.supporting_quote: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) is facing a new multistate investigation as 42 state attorneys general coordinate AI oversight efforts.

claims.claim: A Washington state filing lists 277 Microsoft positions eliminated in the Seattle region, including 77 in art and game roles and 60 in software engineering.
claims.episode_span: A Washington state filing lists 277 positions Microsoft eliminated in the Seattle region
claims.source_title: Artists, game designers and producers hit hard as Microsoft cuts 277 jobs in Washington state
claims.supporting_quote: A new state filing lists all 277 positions Microsoft eliminated in the Seattle region, one job title at a time. Art, game production, game design, technical art and audio design account for 77 of them, with software engineering the largest single category at 60.

claims.claim: Apple and Qualcomm renewed their global patent licensing agreement, extending a deal previously set to expire in 2027.
claims.episode_span: Qualcomm and Apple have renewed their global patent licensing agreement
claims.source_title: Apple and Qualcomm renew global patent licensing agreement
claims.supporting_quote: Qualcomm and Apple have renewed their global patent licensing agreement, extending a deal that was previously set to expire in 2027.

claims.claim: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Live and Live Extended Thinking on September 15, and Live Avatar adds generated video that can lip-sync and react.
claims.episode_span: A week after Google launched Gemini 3.8 Live and Live Extended Thinking on September 15, Live Avatar adds near real-time generated video
claims.source_title: Google has given Gemini 3.8 Live a face that can lip-sync, react, and use tools in the background
claims.supporting_quote: The update comes barely a week after Google launched Gemini 3.8 Live and Live Extended Thinking on September 15.

claims.claim: Live Avatar supports 97 languages, is available through Gemini Enterprise, allows custom avatars from a reference image for approved customers, can call tools in the background, and carries SynthID watermarking.
claims.episode_span: with 97 languages and speech, lip movements, and expressions that adjust without restarting the conversation
claims.source_title: Google has given Gemini 3.8 Live a face that can lip-sync, react, and use tools in the background
claims.supporting_quote: Language support is fairly broad, with 97 languages, adjusting its speech, lip movements, and expressions along the way without Google saying users need to restart the conversation.

claims.claim: TechRadar reported that Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking outperformed GPT-Live-1 Astra and Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 across multiple benchmarks and was cheaper per hour of input audio.
claims.episode_span: Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking outperformed GPT-Live-1 Astra and Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 across multiple benchmarks
claims.source_title: Google's creepy new Gemini Live Avatars want to try and make online support bots feel more human
claims.supporting_quote: A more hardcore version of that model, 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, outperformed GPT-Live-1 Astra and Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 across multiple benchmarks while still ending up cheaper to run per hour of input audio.
